data.text: At least 17 people were killed and 35 others injured in a stampede during celebrations for the Hindu festival of Durga Puja in the eastern Indian city of Kolkata on Saturday evening, local media reported. https://t.co/oYqtVI2ISf https://t.co/ZIArmBnIRq

urls.description: For the past eighteen years, the Council on Foreign Relations has conducted an annual Preventive Priorities Survey (PPS) to help policymakers anticipate and avert international crises that threaten U.S. national interests. Carried out by the Wachenheim Center for Peace and Security, the PPS evaluates ongoing and potential violent conflicts and sources of instability based on their likelihood of occurring in the coming year and their potential harm to U.S. interests. We value your suggestions for which conflicts to include in the 2027 PPS. When submitting suggestions, please keep in mind that they should only comprise a specific event rather than a broad trend. For example, while global warming, environmental degradation, disease outbreaks, and demographic pressures could affect instability and violent conflict, they are not sufficiently specific to include in the PPS.
